Planned Bogotá itinerary:
- Visit the Gold Museum (Museo del Oro) in La Candelaria and learn about pre-Columbian Indigenous cultures, goldwork, and the effects/history of the Spanish conquest.
- Grab a snack or quick lunch at a café or restaurant near the museum or Plaza de Bolívar.
- Explore Plaza de Bolívar, including the Cathedral, Capitolio Nacional, Palacio Liévano/ Bogotá City Hall, central Simón Bolívar monument, vendors, performers, and surrounding historic streets.
- Potentially visit nearby La Candelaria landmarks such as Plaza del Chorro de Quevedo (not “de”), Iglesia de San Francisco, Museo de la Independencia/Museo Casa del Florero, Casa de la Moneda, Teatro Colón, colonial streets, street art, cafés, and shops.
